items.title: Launch of a Cooperation Project for Women’s and Girls’ Leadership in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 24 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Senegal, Michele Tommasi, spoke at the first meeting of the National Steering Committee for the Parel/F project—an initiative funded by Italian Cooperation to strengthen the leadership and socioeconomic inclusion of women and girls in Senegal—to reaffirm Italy’s support for this initiative. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.

items.title: Confindustria sounds alarm about outlook amid fresh conflict in the Gulf
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 24 - The CSC research unit of Italian industry association Confindustria on Friday sounded the alarm about the nation's economic outlook following a breakdown of the Iran war ceasefire. "The third quarter is off to a bad start," the CSC said in its latest economic outlook report. "The war in Iran flared up again in July, and uncertainty about future developments is at a peak: oil prices were immediately affected. items.title: Woman, 55, dies two months after being hit in Modena car attack
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 22 - A 55-year-old woman who was among the people hit by a car attack in the northern city of Modena on May 16 has died, the hospital she was being treated at said on Wednesday. Monica Esposito never regained consciousness after the attack by a 31-year-old Italian citizen of Moroccan origin with mental-health problems, Salim El Koudri.
